title: Simple TexturePack by SquadXTeam
description: A stylish and lightweight texture pack with simplified items and custom hearts by SquadXTeam.
body:
**Welcome to Simple TexturePack — a project created with passion by the SquadXTeam! We have combined the best of simplified textures and clean elements to make your Minecraft look sharp and neat.
✨ Key Features:
Improved Items: All main tools and items have been updated with clean, simple textures.
Custom Hearts: We've started our GUI journey by redesigning the health bar hearts for a fresh look.
Performance Boost: Lightweight textures won't lag your PC or phone, ensuring a stable FPS.
SquadXTeam Style: Features a unique pack icon with our signature sword — easy to find in your resource pack list!
🛠️ Technical Info:
Game Version: Minecraft 1.21.1 and above.
Developed by: SquadXTeam.**
